description: This PHP script manages the export of custom fields in the TestLink open-source test management system. It initializes page parameters, handles export requests, and generates XML exports of custom fields from the database, providing a user interface for exporting custom fields in XML format.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for export actions and filenames, also sets user ID and return URL based on session data.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs the export of custom fields to an XML file, retrieves table info, generates XML content via ADODB_XML, and triggers file download.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to view custom fields.
